reason: Pre-alpha from one developer, and it runs agents on our client code overnight with nobody watching. I don't put that near client repos until other teams have used it for months.
objection: Leaving agents alone with client code at night is a security risk, and a solo pre-alpha project gives me no audit trail, no track record and no one to call if it goes wrong.
would_change_my_mind: Case studies from agencies like ours running it on real client work for a few months, plus a clear security write-up on what the agents can touch.
